mapper.select: SELECT pma.marketing_id, pma.marketing_type, pma.marketing_name, pma.condition_type, pma.condition_value, pma.promotion_tag, pma.valid_grade, pma.join_limit, pma.start_time, pma.end_time, pma.canjoin_repeat, pma.use_shop, pma.in_proportion FROM promotions_marketing_activity AS pma WHERE pma.start_time <= #{nowTs} AND pma.end_time >= #{nowTs} AND pma.company_id = #{companyId} AND pma.source_type = 'distributor' AND pma.source_id = #{distributorId} AND pma.check_status = 'agree' AND pma.marketing_type IN ('full_discount', 'full_minus', 'full_gift') ORDER BY pma.created DESC
